items.headline:
OCTOBER FED HIKE ODDS DROP TO 50%

Markets now price a 50% chance of an October Fed hike, down from around 70%, after Fed’s Williams said there is “no rush to act.”

Williams still sees one more hike potentially needed by year-end, with inflation remaining the Fed’s priority.
